description: Initialises a block of globals and programs CIA-B timer A through its control, high and low count and interrupt registers. It then enables the interrupt through INTENA, touches CIAA_PRA, and makes one call to an unnamed routine.

name: clear_flag_set_dma_interrupts
description: Clears bit one of a shared flag and then writes three fixed constants to the DMA control and interrupt enable registers. It also touches CIAA_PRA, and one unnamed routine calls it.

name: step_audio_channel_handlers
description: Counts a byte down and, while it is non-zero, runs three channel handlers chosen through a table indexed by a nibble. It updates the audio channel location registers AUD0LCH to AUD3LCH, touches CIAB_CRA, and makes one call.

name: write_timer_and_request_registers
description: Writes a counter value, a value derived from it and a copied word to shared globals, then finishes with the constant 8192. It touches the CIA-B control and interrupt registers, DMACON and INTREQ, and one unnamed routine calls it.

name: reset_audio_channel_registers
description: Adjusts a shared value, then writes eight table entries into the pointer and length registers of all four audio channels. It finishes by writing the constant 8192 to the interrupt request register, and the listed facts record no callers.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: The pseudo-code could not be recovered, so the evidence is that it makes two calls to unnamed routines across 60 instructions. One unnamed routine calls it, and it is entered from an executed reference run.

name: select_tracker_effect_nibble
description: Works out a modulo-three step from two channel bytes, then either writes a stored word into a record field or picks a nibble of its argument and processes a 72-byte table entry. It is entered from an executed reference run, and the listed facts record no calls.

name: decrease_position_with_floor
description: Subtracts a delta from a position field in a record, raises the position to a floor of 113 when it falls below that, and copies the result into an output field. One unnamed routine calls it.

name: adjust_nibble_level_with_clamp
description: Adjusts a byte level in a record from a packed argument, subtracting the low nibble and clamping at zero when the high nibble is zero, or adding the high nibble and clamping at 64 otherwise. It copies the result to an output byte, and no callers are recorded.

name: store_level_argument_directly
description: Stores its argument into a record byte field and copies it to an output word. It is reached only as an unreached gap, and no callers are recorded.
